item.title: 007 First Light Story Trailer reveals Orlebar Brown pieces worn by Bond
item.description: The latest trailer for the upcoming First Light video game reveals a re-imagined origin story as James Bond enters the 00 Programme as a promising young recruit. It also might have given us a first look at one of the Orlebar Brown pieces worn by Bond.

item.title: Quintessentially Bond: The Charity Auction
item.description: This March, MovieMania will host the Quintessentially Bond Charity Auction in support of York Against Cancer.

item.title: Time Capsule hidden in NFTS The Cubby Broccoli Building
item.description: EON Productions is supporting the National Film and Television School with the construction of the Broccoli Building, ‘The Cubby’ set to open in 2027.

item.title: Aston Martin V8 driven by Daniel Craig as James Bond in No Time To Die for sale
item.description: Luxury car dealer Tom Hartley is offering the 1981 Aston Martin V8, which was driven by Daniel Craig as James Bond in No Time To Die.

item.title: Never-before-seen footage On Her Majesty's Secret Service - The Blofeld Files
item.description: The authors of The Blofeld Files have released never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage of On Her Majesty's Secret Service.

item.title: Casino Royale Leather-bound Hardback Book Queen Anne Press Numbered Edition
item.description: Ian Fleming Publications has released a very special collector's leather-bound edition of Casino Royale, published by Ian Fleming’s own imprint Queen Anne Press.

item.title: 1964 Aston Martin DB5 with Goldfinger gadgets for sale
item.description: Luxury car dealer Tom Hartley Junior offers a rare, original 1964 Aston Martin DB5 with custom-added Goldfinger gadgets.

item.title: Win Ian Fleming Complete Paperback Box Set
item.description: Win Ian Fleming Complete Paperback Box Set Remmert Thu, 03/19/2026 - 22:11 #97 Bond Lifestyle Contest: Win The Complete 007 Paperback Collection

item.title: Ian Fleming’s James Bond Signature Comic Strip Collection Vol.1
item.description: A new 007 Comic Strip Collection features the first seven full-length James Bond newspaper comic-strip adventures that helped inspire the James Bond cinematic universe.

item.title: M's 1954 Rolls-Royce Phantom IV in On Her Majesty's Secret Service
item.description: In the 1969 film On Her Majesty's Secret Service, we get a very brief look at the black Rolls-Royce owned by M (Bernard Lee), Head of the British Secret Service MI6.

item.title: All 25 James Bond Movies will leave Netflix
item.description: The availability of the James Bond films on streaming platforms continues to shift. Following earlier runs on platforms such as Pluto TV and Amazon in late 2025, the full catalogue of EON-produced Bond films appeared on Netflix at the beginning of 2026.

item.title: Daniel Craig new brand ambassador for Chinese EV brand DENZA
item.description: Chinese car manufacturer BYD has announced that British actor Daniel Craig will be featuring in their new DENZA campaign.

item.title: The James Bond Diamonds Are Forever Soundtrack Double CD Set - 55th Anniversary Expanded Remastered Edition
item.description: To celebrate 55 Years of Diamonds Are Forever, La-La Land Records has announced a remastered and expanded 2-CD re-issue of composer John Barry’s original motion picture score to Diamonds Are Forever.

item.title: Browning Hi-Power
item.description: James Bond has used a Browning Hi-Power pistol in two movies: Casino Royale (2006) and No Time To Die (2021).

item.title: King Zero by Charlie Higson - the new James Bond continuation novel
item.description: Penguin Michael Joseph in partnership with Ian Fleming Publications have revealed a new James Bond continuation novel: King Zero by Charlie Higson.
